mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_temp_file ( uid, file_type, object_key, original_filename, content_type, file_size, status, expire_at ) VALUES ( #{uid}, #{fileType}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{expireAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, file_type, object_key, original_filename, content_type, file_size, status, expire_at, created_at, updated_at FROM upload_temp_file WHERE object_key = #{objectKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_temp_file SET status = 2 WHERE object_key = #{objectKey} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, file_type, object_key, original_filename, content_type, file_size, status, expire_at, created_at, updated_at FROM upload_temp_file WHERE status = 0 AND expire_at < #{now} ORDER BY expire_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
